gen-dafont-neon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters out like stencil bridges pulled wide. Neon lights the heading with one unbroken line, while the mono text below stays approachable and lets the loud top share the page.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-biryani: Glowing Neon stamps out tall lowercase like metal type, with each letter given open space. Biryani then reads smoothly, its large-eyed e and open little counters keeping paragraphs unclogged from line to line.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-blinker: Neon glow, then solid ground: the heading hums with one unbroken line and tall stamped-metal lowercase. Blinker takes over where reading matters, with open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Neon glows with no hairlines to squint at, every letter drawn in one unbroken line. Carrois Gothic SC is the sans for steadier text, its curves opening clearly and capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-chivo: Glowing and steady: Neon holds its pen pressure from the first letter to the last. And Chivo, a sans-serif with lowercase packed toward the caps, does the quieter job with daylight in every curve.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-comme: Comme draws smooth, unclogged curves, with lowercase bodies taking up most of the letter height. But Neon is the showpiece, its rounded-nib strokes ending without any swelling, while Comme handles the modern text.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-duru-sans: Squeezed-toothpaste lines, glowing and steady: that is Neon, one stroke the whole way through. Then Duru Sans takes over, its wide openings on small letters letting bodies dominate while ascenders hardly show.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-fresca: Glow first: Neon runs one unbroken line through every letter, with open space between each pair. Then Fresca, a sans-serif with no calligraphic thinning, keeps its counters connected outside, so paragraphs flow without snagging.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-funnel-sans: Glow and stamped metal: Neon draws tall lowercase forms in one unbroken line. Funnel Sans is the sans that does the plain talking, with stroke widths holding steady and an e opened like a pried clasp.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-geist: Bright, unbroken glow up top, with Neon leaving space between every letter. Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, so words settle into solid blocks rather than skylines.
